annotations.description: Rolling 24h input tokens by source-log timestamp. jev uses captured result.usage.input_tokens from the outer Workers AI response leg, once per gateway/log ID, excluding the paired provider leg and replay copies. Missing bodies or invalid usage are omitted. Every other model keeps its request-log gen_ai.usage.input_tokens sum. This model-specific reconciliation is not universal billable accounting. Normal days are 15-40M. The 2026-10-19 spike was 355M, almost all from jg calls in loop lanes. Check which loops are running jg heavily, using the agent-history catalogue.
annotations.summary: AI Gateway input tokens over the last 24h: {{ humanize $values.B.Value }} (threshold 150M)

model.expr: ((sum(max by (cloudflare_ai_gateway_gateway_name, cloudflare_ai_gateway_log_id) (max_over_time({service_name="cf2otel"} | event_name="gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details" | gen_ai_request_model="jev" | gen_ai_provider_name="workers-ai" | cloudflare_ai_gateway_content_side="response" | cloudflare_ai_gateway_gateway_name!="" | cloudflare_ai_gateway_log_id!="" | json in="result.usage.input_tokens" | unwrap in | __error__="" [24h])))) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="cf2otel"} | event_name="cloudflare.ai_gateway.request" | gen_ai_request_model!="jev" | unwrap gen_ai_usage_input_tokens [24h])) or vector(0))
